manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Lagrella, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Lagrella until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
